# netbox_module (Resource)

Manages a NetBox module (`/api/dcim/modules/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_module" "example" {
  device_id = netbox_device.example.id
  module_bay_id = netbox_module_bay.example.id
  module_type_id = netbox_module_type.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number) ID of the Device (`netbox_device`).
- `module_bay_id` (Number) ID of the Module Bay (`netbox_module_bay`).
- `module_type_id` (Number) ID of the Module Type (`netbox_module_type`).

### Optional

- `adopt_components` (Boolean) Adopt already existing components. Write-only: NetBox does not return this value.
- `asset_tag` (String) A unique tag used to identify this device.
- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `replicate_components` (Boolean) Automatically populate components associated with this module type (default: true). Write-only: NetBox does not return this value.
- `serial` (String) Serial. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `status` (String) Status. Valid values: `offline`, `active`, `planned`, `staged`, `failed`, `decommissioning`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_module can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_module.example 123
```
